name: Minds Public API
description: OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec for the Minds public API (https://getminds.ai/api/v1 / https://api.getminds.ai/v1). Generate a typed TypeScript client by running an OpenAPI generator (e.g. `openapi-typescript`) against `/_openapi.json`. Auth: send `Authorization: Bearer minds_…_key`; create keys in Settings → API Keys.
